# openstack-cinder-provider-kog — LLM doc index
# A Krateo KOG provider exposing OpenStack Cinder block-storage v3 volumes as the Volume kind
# (blockstorage.openstack.krateo.io/v3-0). The chart ships a curated OpenAPI 3.0 subset, one
# RestDefinition and a Keystone auth-bridge proxy; oasgen-provider generates the CRDs and runs the
# controller. Version 0.1.0: create, get, delete; no update; no findby; Ready means the volume exists.
README.md: the front door; the oasgen-provider minimum; the project-less URL decision and its sources
docs/index.md: the map of the bundle and the repository layout
docs/overview.md: the pipeline, where each OpenAPI field comes from (cinder stable/2026.1 file and line), and every design decision
docs/usage.md: install with helm or through Krateo, the blueprint's credentials, create, wait for available, delete, troubleshooting
docs/configuration.md: every chart value, the blueprint credential mapping, the VolumeConfiguration
docs/api.md: the generated Volume and VolumeConfiguration CRDs, field by field, and the Composition kind
docs/examples.md: index of the examples
docs/release.md: tag -> preflight -> shared release-oci 2.1.0 -> GHCR and the helm index, blueprints channel; pre-releases (prerelease.yaml, GHCR only, run artifact)
docs/log.md: curated history
examples/composition/README.md: install through the CompositionDefinition
examples/bootable-volume/README.md: a bootable Volume and a data Volume, the shape of #308 run B
chart/assets/volume.yaml: the curated OpenAPI 3.0 subset, with a source for every schema
chart/templates/rd-volume.yaml: the Volume RestDefinition, its verbs and why there is no update or findby
chart/scripts/openstack-auth-proxy.py: the auth-bridge, identical to glance-kog's
compositiondefinition.yaml: registers the chart; the release ships it inside the package
hack/README.md: the CI gates and the release hook
.github/workflows/prerelease.yaml: dispatch-only pre-release to GHCR, X.Y.Z-main.g<sha7>, never the index, a release or a tag
